subject.title: refactor(release): simplify monthly extended-stable plugin snapshots

question: Should this stacked PR become OpenClaw's supported monthly extended-stable plugin snapshot contract after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100111 lands?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but it changes protected release automation, npm candidate publication, selector-promotion assumptions, and existing-user extended-stable plugin convergence; automation should not decide that release contract.

options.title: Review After Dependency Lands
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100111 to land, rebase this branch, then release owners review the exact workflow graph, package guard, selector handoff, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow Runtime First
options.body: Split or defer the publication orchestration if maintainers want only runtime/docs snapshot convergence reviewed in this branch.

options.title: Pause For Selector Owner
options.body: Hold the PR if the protected private selector consumer cannot safely promote plugin selectors first and core last from schema v2 handoff evidence.

recommendation.title: Review After Dependency Lands
recommendation.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100111 to land, rebase this branch, then release owners review the exact workflow graph, package guard, selector handoff, and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: kevinslin authored the recent current-main extended-stable foundations and this stacked follow-up, so they are the best available owner for the release-contract decision.
